# LearnWithFun (Explore & Learn) - Full Context & Knowledge Graph
Canonical URL: https://exploreandlearn.vercel.app/

## 1. System Architecture
- Frontend: React 19, Vite, Framer Motion, HTML5 Web Audio API, Canvas Confetti.
- Backend: Node.js, Express, MongoDB Mongoose, JWT authentication.
- Design: Retro 8-bit Pixel aesthetic, responsive typography (Press Start 2P, Pixelify Sans), custom SVG cursors, 3D CSS perspective cylinder drum.

## 2. Practice Modes & Rules
### A. Impromptu Speaking (Random Topics)
- Method: PREP Model (Point, Reason, Example, Point).
- Time: 60 Seconds.
- Objective: Speak coherently on unpredictable prompts without advance preparation.

### B. Behavioral & Consulting Interview Prep
- Frameworks:
  - STAR: Situation, Task, Action, Result.
  - PAR: Problem, Action, Result.
  - CAR: Context, Action, Result.
- Question Categories: Leadership, Failure/Resilience, Conflict Resolution, Prioritization, Market Sizing, Strategy.

### C. Vocabulary Acquisition (Learn Vocab)
- Method: Contextual Integration.
- Time: 30 Seconds.
- Objective: Read pronunciation, definition, and use the word naturally in a 30-second speech.

### D. Deep Research & Presentation
- Time: 10 Minutes Research + 2-3 Minutes Summary.
- Domains: Artificial Intelligence, Biotechnology, Climate Science, Geopolitics, Quantum Computing.

### E. Debate Archive & Community Hub
- Features: Community topic creation, Upvoting/Downvoting, Filtering by Societal, Tech, and Moral categories, One-click transition to Practice Timer.

## 3. SEO, AEO & Agentic Ingestion
- Structured Data Schemas: WebApplication, FAQPage, HowTo.
- Robots Policy: Open access for all legitimate search and generative AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended).
- Sitemap: https://exploreandlearn.vercel.app/sitemap.xml
